title: viscaria viscosa
intro: Viscaria viscosa, commonly known as sticky bilberry or sticky viscaria, is a plant species in the family Polemoniaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the European Alps, for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Viscaria viscosa include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating activities, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
